req.title: Set cookie via path
req.statement: The system shall set a cookie of name=<name>, value=<value> and redirect to /cookies when GET /cookies/set/<name>/<value> is called.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that GET /cookies/set/<name>/<value> sets a cookie and issues a 302 redirect to /cookies. Tests must verify: (1) positive path — correct 302 status, Set-Cookie header with exact name/value, Location header pointing to /cookies; (2) negative path — missing path segments yield 404; (3) boundary — single-character name/value, empty-string-like edge values, and special characters. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (302 not 301/303), exact Location header value, exact cookie name and value in Set-Cookie header, and verifying the redirect target is precisely /cookies.

tests.name: test_set_cookie_via_path_positive_standard
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
No pre-existing cookies in test client
trace: R-HTTPBIN-030: set cookie via path -> 302 redirect to /cookies with Set-Cookie
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_via_path_positive_standard():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/testname/testvalue', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location == '/cookies' or location.endswith('/cookies')
    set_cookie = r.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert 'testname' in set_cookie
    assert 'testvalue' in set_cookie

test_set_cookie_via_path_positive_standard()

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_via_path_negative_missing_both_segments():
    # /cookies/set without path params hits the query-string handler, not set_cookie
    r = client.get('/cookies/set', follow_redirects=False)
    # Should be 302 from set_cookies (query-string handler) with no cookies set
    assert r.status_code == 302
    set_cookie = r.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    # No cookie should be set since no query params provided
    assert set_cookie == ''

import json
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_via_path_state_transition_set_then_view():
    r1 = client.get('/cookies/set/statekey/stateval', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r1.status_code == 302
    set_cookie_header = r1.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert 'statekey' in set_cookie_header
    assert 'stateval' in set_cookie_header

    data = json.loads(r2.data)
    assert data['cookies']['statekey'] == 'stateval'

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_via_path_location_header_exact():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/k/v', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    # Must end with /cookies, not /cookies/set or /cookies/set/k/v
    assert location.endswith('/cookies')
    assert not location.endswith('/cookies/set')
    assert not location.endswith('/cookies/set/k/v')
    assert '/cookies' in location
